name: Xingdeng Zhuiye
source:
An Illuminator living in the Starshard Beacon. She is the keyboardist in the super-popular band, "Starkiss." She is responsible for handling the external affairs of the band. When the band encounters matters requiring external negotiation, she is usually the one to handle it. She is a retired Arboranger.

[spoiler]Now that Wishia and Blessa have picked up their Illumiarms and entered the battlefield, Adorna Starcloud, the oldest member in the squad, will of course stick together with the other members. Adorna was responsible for the training of this idol band, helping them become reliable warriors.[/spoiler]
